files.file: added get_log and update_log (replaces photo rows in order, no commit)
added PUT /api/logs/{id}, _update, _exists; _validate_files gained a minimum param
inline edit form (startEdit/cancelEdit), Edit button wired in renderLog

tests.test: 100 pass, 1 fails: test_real_paths_untouched, because the real uploads/ already holds 2 files dated before this run (not touched by me)

design_decisions.decision: One post in edit mode at a time (starting another edit cancels the first); rejected several-at-once because a list reload would wipe other open edits.
404 checked first via a cheap existence query, before parsing the body; rejected 404 only inside _update so no file reads happen for unknown ids. _update re-checks too.
update_log deletes and reinserts all photo rows with fresh positions; rejected per-row position updates as more code for the same result.
Old files deleted after commit, errors logged only; removed photo file path derived from the basename in uploads_dir.
Edit view hides the original children rather than removing them, so Cancel restores them untouched with no request.

implementation.self_critique: Frontend is unverified by real clicks (only node --check). A successful create while editing reloads the list and discards the open edit. Pre-existing __pycache__ in backend/ and 2 files in real uploads/ were present before my run.
